dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical indentation on the left lateral margin relative to the more convex right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity light grey to off-white across the primary dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey pigmentation clusters located primarily along the posterior lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the primary light-grey baseline and localized darker peripheral shading.
